the state of the practice of template‐based protein modeling is high, with most of the groups performing better than the naïve control predictor, but the state of the science of the field is not yet high, as most groups are still not able to produce highly accurate models and provide reliable confidence estimates.

the state of the practice of template based modeling is high, with most of the groups performing well, and with a few groups clearly performing better than the rest, that the submissions by “human groups” are dominated by meta predictors, with one group clearly performing better than others, and that the accuracy of predictions of homo oligomeric assemblies is overall poor.
the state of the template based protein structure prediction is high, with most of the groups performing well.
